name: Chat
author: marcho78
description: End-to-end encrypted chat from the bar or as a window. Matrix (Olm/Megolm) via the omarchy-chatd daemon; the shell never touches a key.

barWidget.description: Encrypted Matrix chat: rooms, unread count and a composer in a bar panel; middle-click or the App button opens the full window.

schema.label: Homeserver
schema.description: Pre-filled on the login form. Any Matrix homeserver works.

schema.label: Start omarchy-chatd when the panel opens
schema.description: Runs 'systemctl --user start omarchy-chatd' if the daemon is installed but not running.
